title: p11scope/inventory/v1 Task 7 provider/token/mechanism section (version 8)
description: Consumer contract for section version 8 (v0.8.0 keymeta Task 7, spec section 17.5; the v8 number comes from the shared section-version allocator, spec section 10.1, and versions 1-7 stay frozen). Covers the per-module provider_info key on modules[] rows (see #/$defs/provider_info) and the top-level provider_observations section: per-(module, caller, slot) token rows, per-(module, caller, slot, mechanism) mechanism rows with raw mechanism-dependent limit numbers, and the four named gap counters. The section is emitted exactly when Task 7 content is present. Every object is closed: additionalProperties is false at every level, and every enum is exact. There are no keys for excluded bytes anywhere: no serial number, token label, session count, memory size or clock reading key exists in this contract. Rows carry module + caller references resolving in modules[]/edges[]; the instance id rides a row only when the semantic lane proved it, never synthesized. Row counters are cumulative within their row: completions counts polls, changes counts value transitions (first observation sets the value with changes 0); repeats are last-wins, never second entries and never merges.

version.description: Section version. Additive versioned section; consumers must reject unknown versions, never guess.

tokens.description: Token rows, sorted by (module, caller, slot). One row per (module, caller incarnation, slot) by construction; slot ids are per-process, so two callers' same-slot tokens are separate rows.

mechanisms.description: Mechanism rows, sorted by (module, caller, slot, mechanism). Capped at 128 rows per (module, caller, slot); extras refuse with the mechanism_info_refused gap counter.

gaps.description: Named section gaps with counts, in fixed reason order, nonzero rows only.

provider_info.description: Per-module provider facts from completed C_GetInfo calls; rides the modules[] row as provider_info, absent without a completed call. Repeats are last-wins with no counters.

manufacturer.description: Trimmed CK_INFO.manufacturerID; null when refused (non-UTF8), with manufacturer_reason naming why.

description.description: Trimmed CK_INFO.libraryDescription; null when refused (non-UTF8), with description_reason naming why.

module.description: Module id label resolving in modules[] (m0, m1, ...).

caller.description: Caller incarnation id label resolving in callers[] (c0, c1, ...).

manufacturer.description: Trimmed CK_TOKEN_INFO.manufacturerID; null when refused (non-UTF8), with manufacturer_reason naming why.

model.description: Trimmed CK_TOKEN_INFO.model; null when refused (non-UTF8), with model_reason naming why.

flags.description: Whole CK_TOKEN_INFO flags word, including PIN-state bits (policy state, not secrets).

instance.description: Instance id label (i0, i1, ...) attached only when the semantic lane proved it; absent otherwise, never synthesized.

module.description: Module id label resolving in modules[] (m0, m1, ...).

caller.description: Caller incarnation id label resolving in callers[] (c0, c1, ...).

mechanism.description: Numeric mechanism type; no name key exists in this section.

min_key_size.description: Raw CK_MECHANISM_INFO.ulMinKeySize: a mechanism-dependent number (bits or bytes), never a unit claim.

max_key_size.description: Raw CK_MECHANISM_INFO.ulMaxKeySize: a mechanism-dependent number (bits or bytes), never a unit claim.

instance.description: Instance id label (i0, i1, ...) attached only when the semantic lane proved it; absent otherwise, never synthesized.
